name: web-real-estate-dashboard-on-black-project-cover
title: Real Estate Dashboard on Black Cover
whatItIs: A cover with oversized ghosted 'Real Estate' lettering behind a dark screen slab showing a bright dashboard with aerial building images and data cards.
whatItMeans: Black lets the colorful UI glow and feels high-end. Ghost lettering says the subject without competing.
techniques: Faint giant title text behind the device
Screen shown as a thick 3D slab with reflection
Aerial imagery inside cards for context
Bright UI on black for contrast
Bold headline in the product ('3 hot buyers')

vocabulary.definition: Large low-contrast text used as backdrop.
